title: Instructor, Data Analytics
description_html:
About the role

Teach the second year of our data analytics diploma.

What you'll do

  • Teaching two sections of SQL and Tableau each term
  • Mentoring students on capstone projects

What you bring

  • A Master's degree
  • Data visualization

Nice to have

  • Power BI

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $68,000–$74,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
